parts.meaning: The volume in the recipe, measured packed and levelled.

howToSteps.name: Spoon it into the cup
howToSteps.text: Spoon the brown sugar into the measuring cup until it heaps over the top. Do not worry about levelling yet. Packing comes first.

howToSteps.name: Press it down
howToSteps.text: Press the sugar down firmly with the back of a spoon. Add more sugar and press again, until the cup is full and the surface is firm.

howToSteps.name: Level it off
howToSteps.text: Sweep the flat edge of a knife across the rim of the cup. Turn the sugar out and it should hold the shape of the cup. If it falls apart, pack it again.

howToSteps.name: Convert or weigh
howToSteps.text: Weigh the sugar if you have a scale: one packed, level cup should read 213 grams. Or use the converter above. Cups times 213 is grams, grams divided by 213 is cups.

name: Brown Sugar
sourceNote: King Arthur Baking lists brown sugar, dark or light, packed, at 213 g per cup (7 1/2 oz).
title: Cups to Grams: Brown Sugar (Packed)
tutorial: Brown sugar is the one cup you pack. A loosely filled cup holds far less than a packed one, because the soft, moist crystals leave air gaps unless you press them down. King Arthur Baking lists a packed cup of brown sugar at 213 grams, 7 1/2 ounces. That number only holds if you pack it.

Packing is simple. Spoon the sugar into the cup, then press it down firmly with the back of the spoon. Keep adding and pressing until the cup is full and level. When you turn it out, it should hold the shape of the cup. If it crumbles apart, it was not packed.

Light and dark brown sugar weigh the same per packed cup: 213 grams. Dark brown sugar has more molasses, so it tastes deeper and looks darker, but the extra molasses does not change the cup weight. Use either one by the same number.
The converter works in both directions. Cups become grams when you want the scale. Grams become cups when the recipe is in grams. Both directions use the same number: 213 grams per packed cup.

The anchor is the half cup. Half a cup, packed, is about 107 grams. Two cups is 426 grams. One packed tablespoon is 13.3 grams. If a recipe calls for a cup of brown sugar and does not say packed, pack it anyway. That is what the recipe means.
